eos_records.label: (bcc)  (JCPDS 6-0696, EOS from Hanfland SSC )
eos_records.notes: Hanfland et al. report atomic V0 = 21.6225 A^3 fixed, K0 = 11.32(10) GPa, and K0' = 3.62(4). V0 was doubled for the bcc cell. The published 0-21 GPa Vinet fit jointly uses the bcc and fcc compression data; this bcc material entry therefore must not be read as a claim that bcc Li is stable over the whole fit interval.
